0022600193.text: The Warriors, 6-3 and on a six-game winning streak, host the Orlando Magic in their 10th game of the season; Golden State is 4-1 at home and sits 2nd in the Pacific, one game back, and 7th in the West. Orlando comes in 2-6 with three straight losses, 0-4 at home, and 12th in the East, and Izaiyah Nelson, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda and Paolo Banchero are all out. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis and Moses Moody, while Draymond Green, Gary Payton II and Gui Santos are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the Warriors winning the last meeting 120-97 in San Francisco on December 22, 2025.
